name: AuScope Discovery Portal
summary: Map portal that brings together web services from Geoscience Australia, the state and territory geological surveys and research groups, with about 280 layers of geology, mineral occurrences, boreholes, geochemistry, geophysics, tenements and 3D models.

name: Exploring for the Future Data Discovery Portal
summary: View of the Geoscience Australia Portal for data from the Exploring for the Future program, launched in July 2020 with about 250 free datasets from geophysical surveys, geochemical sampling, hydrological mapping and stratigraphic drilling.

name: Geophysical Archive Data Delivery System (GADDS)
summary: Download of magnetic, radiometric, gravity and elevation survey data from the national, state and territory geophysical archives.

name: Geoscience Australia Portal
summary: National map portal for Australian geology, geophysics, mineral deposits and geochemistry, with OGC web services catalogued in GA's eCat.

name: Company Mineral Drillhole and Surface Geochemistry Database (MDHDB)
agency: Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration (Geological Survey of Western Australia)
summary: Over 3 million historic drillholes and 11 million surface samples from open-file company exploration reports (WAMEX), with harmonised assays in ppm.

name: DMPE eBookshop (GSWA publications)
agency: Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration (Geological Survey of Western Australia)
summary: Shop and download site for Geological Survey of Western Australia publications. Reports, Records and Bulletins are free PDFs; printed maps, USB data packages and premium titles are sold.

name: DMPE map services on Data WA (SLIP)
agency: Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration, published through Data WA and SLIP (Landgate)
summary: WA Government spatial platform hosting the Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration's public WMS, WFS and ArcGIS REST services for geology, MINEDEX, drillholes, tenements, MAGIX surveys and statewide magnetics, radiometrics and gravity images.

name: Data and Software Centre (DASC)
agency: Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration (Geological Survey of Western Australia)
summary: Download centre for Western Australia's statewide spatial datasets, geology map series and data packages, including the company drillhole and geochemistry database.

name: GeoVIEW.WA
agency: Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration (Geological Survey of Western Australia)
summary: GSWA's interactive map of statewide geology and resource data, with mines, mineral deposits, petroleum wells and active leases, and searches for GSWA products, WAMEX reports, drillholes, geochemistry, geochronology and historical tenement maps.

name: MAGIX geophysical survey register
agency: Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration (Geological Survey of Western Australia)
summary: Register and repository of Western Australian geophysical survey datasets, mostly submitted by companies under the Mining Act 1978, plus voluntary submissions and government-funded surveys. Public and open-file data download free.

name: MINEDEX (Mines and Mineral Deposits)
agency: Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration (Geological Survey of Western Australia)
summary: Western Australia's database of mines, mineral deposits, prospects and project owners, with locations, geology, commodities, project status and ownership, resource estimates, production and an inventory of abandoned mine sites.

name: WAMEX mineral exploration reports
agency: Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration (Geological Survey of Western Australia)
summary: Over 120,000 company exploration reports for Western Australia, of which more than 105,000 are public, with their raw drilling, geochemistry and 3D data.

name: SARIG (South Australian Resources Information Gateway)
agency: Department for Energy and Mining (Geological Survey of South Australia)
summary: South Australia's map and data gateway, with over 300,000 drillholes, 3 million rock sample analyses, 9,000 mineral occurrences and company reports.

name: GSQ Open Data Portal
summary: One search for Queensland's public geoscience data, including boreholes, geochemistry, airborne and ground geophysics, seismic, mineral occurrences and open-file company reports.

name: GeoResGlobe
summary: Queensland's free map viewer for mining and exploration, with over 600 layers of current and historical resource authorities, geology, boreholes, geophysical surveys and images, mineral occurrences and links to reports in the GSQ Open Data Portal.

name: DIGS (exploration reports)
agency: Geological Survey of New South Wales
summary: Online collection of New South Wales company exploration reports, mine records and survey publications; non-confidential reports can be previewed and downloaded.

name: MinView
agency: Geological Survey of New South Wales
summary: Web map with over 500 layers for New South Wales geology, mineral occurrences, drillholes, geochemistry, geophysics and titles, with downloads.

name: GeoVic
summary: Free map application for Victorian geology, boreholes (over 13,000), geochemistry and earth resources data, with table export; bulk files from the Earth Resources store.

name: Mineral Resources Tasmania digital data
summary: Download catalogue and OGC services for Tasmanian geology, boreholes, samples and observations, airborne geophysics, mining leases and company reports.

name: GEMIS
summary: Repository for Northern Territory open-file company reports and survey data packages, including the DIP001 drillhole and geochemistry compilation (about 2.3 million assay records).

name: STRIKE
summary: Northern Territory web map for geology, titles and exploration data, with downloads of surface geochemistry and drillhole locations.

name: Canadian Database of Geochemical Surveys (CDoGS)
agency: Natural Resources Canada (Geological Survey of Canada)
summary: Catalogue of 1,646 regional geochemical surveys across Canada since the 1950s, with standardised raw data for 292 of them as spreadsheets and KML, plus links to the original publications.

name: Geophysical Data (Geoscience Data Repository)
agency: Natural Resources Canada (Geological Survey of Canada)
summary: National search and download portal for aeromagnetic, airborne electromagnetic, gravity and radiometric survey and compilation data from the Canadian Airborne Geophysical Data Base, plus Canadian Geodetic Survey gravity.

name: NRCan Open S&T Repository (OSTR), formerly GEOSCAN
summary: Natural Resources Canada's repository of scientific and technical publications, including the Geological Survey of Canada and Canada Centre for Remote Sensing publications once listed in GEOSCAN.

name: ARIS Assessment Report Indexing System
summary: Searchable index and PDF copies of 41,761 approved mineral assessment reports filed by industry since 1947, covering geology, geochemistry, geophysics, drilling and prospecting.

name: Assessment report drillhole database (BCGS GeoFile 2025-11 and 2026-11)
summary: Drill collars, lithology logs, samples and assays digitised from BC mineral assessment reports; the 2026 update holds 2,034 drillholes from 205 reports with 211,995 samples and 9.2 million determinations.

name: MINFILE Mineral Inventory
summary: British Columbia's mineral occurrence database, with 16,261 records covering status, commodities, host rocks, geological setting, inventory, production, capsule geology and references.

name: MapPlace 2
summary: The British Columbia Geological Survey's web map for viewing, analysing and downloading the province's geoscience and mineral resource data, with bedrock geology and mineral occurrences also served as WMS and WFS.

name: Yukon Geological Survey integrated data system
summary: Yukon's geoscience data system, holding Yukon MINFILE, assessment reports, publications, regional geochemistry, drillhole locations and compilations, with the same layers served through GeoYukon map services.

name: NTGS Web Apps (References, NORMIN showings, KIDD, KANDD)
summary: Search and download applications for 10,174 NWT geoscience publications and assessment reports, 3,108 mineral showings, kimberlite indicator and diamond data, and kimberlite anomaly and drillhole data.

name: NunavutGeoscience.ca (NUMIN)
summary: Nunavut's geoscience portal, with the NUMIN database of 5,074 references, including assessment reports and open files, 2,757 mineral showings and downloadable digital reports.

name: Alberta metallic and industrial mineral assessment reports
agency: Alberta Energy and Minerals (Coal and Mineral Development Unit)
summary: Search and download of Alberta metallic and industrial mineral assessment reports from 1949 to the present, by assessment number, project name, release date or commodity, with overview reports, boundary maps and supplementary data.

name: Data extracted from Alberta mineral assessment reports (AGS)
summary: Alberta Geological Survey datasets digitised from 328 mineral assessment reports, including over 5,300 drillholes with collars, intervals and assays, plus outcrop, sediment, water and gamma-ray data.

name: Saskatchewan Geoscience Data System (GeoDS)
agency: Saskatchewan Geological Survey (Ministry of Energy and Resources)
summary: Saskatchewan's integrated geoscience data system for searching, viewing and downloading mineral assessment files and geoscience data taken from them or collected by the Survey, including drilling, samples, lithology and structure.

name: Saskatchewan Mining and Petroleum GeoAtlas, SMDI and SMAD
agency: Saskatchewan Ministry of Energy and Resources (Saskatchewan Geological Survey)
summary: Saskatchewan's map viewer for mining and petroleum data, with the Mineral Deposit Index (SMDI) of showing reports and the Mineral Assessment Database (SMAD) of non-confidential assessment files to view or download.

name: Manitoba GIS Map Gallery and geological databases
summary: Manitoba's geoscience map viewer and downloads, covering geology, geophysics, geochronology, mineral occurrences, kimberlite indicators, assessment files, drillhole locations and mineral dispositions, plus the Manitoba Mineral Deposits Database (GeoFile 5).

name: GeologyOntario
summary: Ontario's geoscience portal for assessment files, drill holes, the mineral deposit inventory, abandoned mines and bedrock and Quaternary geology, with an ArcGIS map service and WMS.

name: Ontario Drill Hole Database (ODHD)
summary: Index of more than 126,000 percussion, overburden, sonic and diamond drill holes from Ontario assessment files, with location, company, orientation, depth and flags for assays above cut-offs for gold, silver, base metals and PGE.

name: SIGÉOM (Système d'information géominière du Québec)
agency: Ministère des Ressources naturelles et des Forêts du Québec (Géologie Québec)
summary: Quebec's geomining information system, with 150 years of geoscience data, including geological mapping, mineral occurrences, diamond drillholes, geochemistry, geochronology, geophysics and over 80,000 EXAMINE documents including assessment reports.

name: New Brunswick Geological Survey open data
agency: New Brunswick Department of Natural Resources and Energy Development (Geological Survey)
summary: Open data and ArcGIS services for New Brunswick mineral occurrences, exploration drillholes and trenches, mineral reports of work, mineral claims, bedrock geology, geochronology and till samples.

name: Nova Scotia Mineral Occurrence and Drillhole Databases
agency: Nova Scotia Department of Natural Resources (Geoscience and Mines Branch)
summary: Nova Scotia's Mineral Occurrence Database (over 3,000 occurrences with sample analyses) and Drillhole Database (28,341 drillholes, over 40,000 references, 6,597 with core at Stellarton), compiled from assessment reports and publications.

name: Newfoundland and Labrador GeoScience Atlas, MODS and GeoFiles
agency: Geological Survey of Newfoundland and Labrador (Department of Natural Resources)
summary: Newfoundland and Labrador's GeoScience OnLine, with the GeoScience Atlas of geology, geophysics, geochemistry, mineral occurrences and mineral lands, the MODS mineral occurrence database and GeoFiles, the index of reports including assessment reports.

name: Earth MRI data releases
agency: U.S. Geological Survey (Earth Mapping Resources Initiative)
summary: Data from the USGS Earth Mapping Resources Initiative, including airborne magnetic, radiometric and electromagnetic surveys and new geochemistry, published as ScienceBase data releases, with a map of acquisition projects.

name: Mineral Resources Online Spatial Data (MRDS, NGDB rock, NURE-HSSR)
summary: USGS map and download site for national mineral resource data, including the Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS), 414,304 rock geochemistry records from the National Geochemical Database and 397,625 NURE-HSSR sediment records.

name: National Geologic Map Database (NGMDB)
agency: U.S. Geological Survey and Association of American State Geologists
summary: National archive of US geological maps, mandated by the Geologic Mapping Act of 1992. Its catalogue holds more than 100,000 maps and reports from over 600 publishers, with mapView, the Geolex names lexicon and the GeMS map database standard.

name: USGS Geochemical Data Portal (rock, sediment, soil and mineral samples)
summary: Interactive map and data release of geochemical analyses for 1,524,014 rock, sediment, soil and mineral samples from the United States and territories, analysed from 1962 to 2023.

name: USMIN Mineral Deposit Database
summary: A developing national database of the most important mines, mineral deposits and mineral districts of the United States, released commodity by commodity (cobalt, gallium, lithium, tungsten and others) with map, OGC services and downloads.

name: Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology data and mining district files
agency: Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology (University of Nevada, Reno)
summary: Nevada's state survey data, with an open data site and map services for mines, mining districts, critical minerals and geochemistry, and scanned mining district files of historical maps, reports, assays and production records.

name: AZGS Document Repository and Mining Data (AZLibrary)
summary: Arizona's geological reports and maps since 1915, free with no log-in, and thousands of historic mine files, photographs and maps from the former Arizona Department of Mines and Mineral Resources (ADMMR).

name: Alaska DGGS geochemistry, geophysics and Geologic Materials Center
agency: Alaska Division of Geological & Geophysical Surveys
summary: Alaska's state survey data, including a searchable geochemistry tool drawn from DGGS, U.S. Bureau of Mines, BLM and USGS publications, airborne geophysical surveys, and the inventory of the Geologic Materials Center sample repository.

name: Alaska Resource Data File (ARDF)
summary: USGS descriptions of 7,448 mines, prospects and mineral occurrences in Alaska, compiled by 1:250,000 quadrangle from published literature and unpublished industry, U.S. Bureau of Mines and USGS records.

name: Minnesota DNR Drill Core Library and mineral exploration documents
agency: Minnesota Department of Natural Resources (Lands and Minerals Division)
summary: Locations of exploration, scientific and engineering borings statewide since the early 1900s, many with core in the DNR Drill Core Library at Hibbing, and footprints of more than 10,000 scanned mineral exploration documents.

name: Database of the Mines and Prospects of Idaho (DD-1)
summary: Free database of more than 8,000 mining properties in Idaho (version 1.2023), with production figures and fields from MRDS and the U.S. Bureau of Mines MILS, plus scanned mineral property files to order.

name: Montana Bureau of Mines and Geology publications and analytical datasets
agency: Montana Bureau of Mines and Geology (Montana Technological University)
summary: Montana's state survey catalogue of publications and maps, including a free Analytical Dataset series with whole-rock assays from mines, mine waste and rare earth deposits, and U-Pb geochronology, each with a DOI.

name: Michigan DNR mineral leases
summary: State mineral leases, lease nominations and parcel lease classifications from the DNR land ownership system, as open data and a feature service.

name: Michigan Geological Repository for Research and Education (MGRRE)
summary: Michigan's repository of more than 600,000 feet of core and cuttings and records from over 50,000 wells, with a borehole inventory map, inventory spreadsheets, core photos and 3D scans.

name: BGS GeoIndex (onshore)
summary: BGS map viewer for Great Britain with borehole records, 1:50,000 geology, geochemistry samples, gravity and magnetic anomalies, airborne surveys and mineral occurrences, with clip-and-download for an area.

name: BGS OpenGeoscience
summary: BGS free data service with over a million borehole scans, scanned maps and sections from 1832, publications from 1835, the GeoScenic photo archive, downloadable map datasets and a geology WMS.

name: GSNI GeoIndex
summary: GSNI map viewer for Northern Ireland with geology, mineral occurrences, mineral resources, mineral and petroleum licences, Tellus airborne geophysics, gravity, geochemistry and borehole records.

name: GSNI open data on Open Data NI (Tellus and minerals)
summary: GSNI datasets on Open Data NI, including Tellus airborne magnetics, radiometrics and electromagnetics (line data and grids), stream sediments, stream waters, rural soils, 1:250,000 geology, mineral resources and the core and cuttings list.

name: Geological Survey Ireland minerals data
summary: GSI minerals downloads and services for Ireland, including mineral localities, about 10,000 mineral exploration boreholes drilled 1957-2002, historic soil geochemistry, the quarry directory, the core store catalogue and open-file exploration records.

name: Tellus (Geological Survey Ireland)
summary: Tellus airborne magnetics, radiometrics and electromagnetics (line data and grids, merged to 2022) and stream sediment, stream water and topsoil geochemistry for Ireland, as downloads and map services.

name: SGU geological data
summary: SGU open data for Sweden, including about 20,000 mineral and rock occurrences, boreholes and drill cores with hyperspectral core scans, mineral permits, ores and concentrators, bedrock, airborne magnetics, gamma, gravity and petrophysics.

name: Hakku (GTK search and download service)
summary: GTK's search and download service for Finnish publications, archived reports, maps, photographs and spatial datasets, including mineral deposit and drill core products. Most products are free; some are sold.

name: Mineral Deposits and Exploration (MDaE) map service
summary: GTK map service for Finnish mineral deposits, mines, extractive waste sites, exploration and drilling sites, with geophysics and geology layers. Each deposit links to the RAKKA interface.

name: NGU Geoscience Portal
summary: NGU's access point for airborne magnetics, radiometrics, resistivity, FDEM and VLF surveys, petrophysics and gravity in Norway, with survey metadata, compilations and a download manager.

name: NGU mineral resources database
summary: NGU map and data for Norwegian metallic ores, industrial minerals and natural stone deposits, with fact sheets, WMS services and county or national downloads through Geonorge.

name: GEUS Dataverse - Greenland Data Centre
agency: Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland (GEUS)
summary: GEUS data repository for Greenland with exploration data packages (zinc, nickel, diamonds), nationwide rock, soil and stream sediment geochemistry, airborne EM and magnetic surveys and 1:100,000 geological maps, each with a DOI.

name: Greenland Mineral Occurrence Map (GMOM) and Greenland Portal
agency: Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland (GEUS)
summary: GEUS map of known mineral occurrences in Greenland with geological summaries, served through the Greenland Portal web map and as WMS, WFS, shapefile and GeoJSON.

name: National Geological Database (NGD) and portal
summary: Saudi Geological Survey database and map portal with geological maps, mineral occurrences (MODS), regional geochemistry, geophysics, boreholes and core library data, bibliography, relinquished licence data and mineral potential reports.

name: SGS technical reports, books and maps database
summary: Saudi Geological Survey catalogue of technical reports, open-file reports, books and maps, searchable by originator (USGS, BRGM, Riofinex, DGMR, DMMR, SGS and others), author, year, report type, title and abstract.

name: Taadeen mining platform
agency: Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources (run by ESNAD, Saudi Mining Services Company)
summary: Saudi digital mining platform for licence applications, the mining map, sector data and exploration licensing rounds. Qualified bidders select sites through it.

name: Bhukosh (GSI geoscience portal)
summary: GSI's GIS portal for viewing, searching and downloading geological, mineral, geophysical and seismotectonic maps and GSI reports; downloads go through a unified cart for registered users.

name: National Geoscience Data Repository (NGDR)
agency: Geological Survey of India, Ministry of Mines
summary: India's repository for exploration geoscience data under the National Mineral Exploration Policy 2016, with legacy and exploration block data standardised to the MERT template and searchable by state, commodity, agency and stage.

name: National Mineral Inventory (NMI)
agency: Indian Bureau of Mines, Ministry of Mines
summary: Computerised inventory of India's mineral deposits kept by the Indian Bureau of Mines since 1970, covering 64 minerals in over 5,500 freehold and 7,500 leasehold deposits and blocks, with reserves and resources, location, geology and exploration.
